An '''Aqualish''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] was present at the diner of [[Panky's]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="OFD">{{OutboundFlightDate}}</ref> At that time, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Lorana Jinzler]] were also present, who were in fact, following [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente's]] bodyguard, [[Jerv Riske]]. In an attempt to eavesdrop on a conversation between the diner's bartender and Riske, Kenobi and Skywalker got near the Aqualish, and the bodyguard, however, Skywalker accidentally punched the Aqualish's drink. After he lost some drops of his drink, the Aqualish entered a rage and almost attacked the Jedi Padawan. However, Kenobi told him that they were sorry, and that it had been an accident, and bought a bigger drink to avoid a fight. Then, the Aqualish told Kenobi that his apprentice required self-discipline.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aqualish appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
